parameters.jsCode:
const item = $json;
function q(value) { return String(value ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''"); }
function json(value) { return JSON.stringify(value ?? {}).replace(/'/g, "''"); }
const metadata = {
  source_channel: 'chatwoot_waba',
  profile_name: item.profile_name || null,
  chatwoot_account_id: item.chatwoot_account_id || null,
  chatwoot_inbox_id: item.chatwoot_inbox_id || null,
  chatwoot_inbox_name: item.chatwoot_inbox_name || null,
  chatwoot_conversation_id: item.chatwoot_conversation_id || null,
  chatwoot_message_id: item.chatwoot_message_id || null,
  provider_message_id: item.provider_message_id || null,
  normalized_route: item.normalized_route || null,
  button_payload: item.button_payload || null,
  button_text: item.button_text || null,
  media_attachment_id: item.media_attachment_id || null,
  media_attachment_count: Number(item.media_attachment_count || 0),
  media_mime_type: item.media_mime_type || null,
  media_file_name: item.media_file_name || null,
  media_file_size: Number.isFinite(Number(item.media_file_size)) ? Number(item.media_file_size) : null,
  routing_status: item.routing_status || null,
  salesforce_http_status: item.salesforce_http_status || null,
  sf_account_id: item.sf_account_id || null,
  sf_contract_id: item.sf_contract_id || null,
};

const sql = "SET search_path TO renovation_dev, public;\n" +
"WITH inbound AS (\n" +
"  SELECT '" + q(item.phone_e164) + "'::text AS phone,\n" +
"         '" + q(item.message_id) + "'::text AS wa_message_id,\n" +
"         '" + q(item.message_text) + "'::text AS content,\n" +
"         '" + q(item.message_type || 'text') + "'::text AS message_type,\n" +
"         '" + q(item.message_timestamp) + "'::timestamptz AS occurred_at,\n" +
"         '" + q(item.chatwoot_conversation_id || '') + "'::text AS chatwoot_conversation_id,\n" +
"         '" + json(metadata) + "'::jsonb AS metadata\n" +
"), customer_matches AS (\n" +
"  SELECT account.*, count(*) OVER ()::integer AS match_count FROM quicklink_account_assignments account\n" +
"   WHERE account.phone = (SELECT phone FROM inbound) AND account.deleted_at IS NULL\n" +
"), customer_match AS (\n" +
"  SELECT * FROM customer_matches WHERE match_count = 1 LIMIT 1\n" +
"), vehicle_candidates AS (\n" +
"  SELECT vehicle.*, count(*) OVER ()::integer AS vehicle_count FROM quicklink_vehicle_assignments vehicle\n" +
"  JOIN customer_match account ON account.id = vehicle.customer_id\n" +
"  WHERE vehicle.deleted_at IS NULL\n" +
"), vehicle_context AS (\n" +
"  SELECT * FROM vehicle_candidates\n" +
"  WHERE vehicle_count = 1 OR salesforce_vehicle_id = NULLIF('" + q(item.sf_vehicle_id || '') + "', '')\n" +
"  ORDER BY salesforce_vehicle_id LIMIT 1\n" +
"), vehicle_options AS (\n" +
"  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('salesforce_vehicle_id', salesforce_vehicle_id, 'brand', brand, 'model', model, 'service_name', service_name, 'gps_status', gps_status) ORDER BY salesforce_vehicle_id), '[]'::jsonb) AS options FROM vehicle_candidates\n" +
"), vehicle_status AS (\n" +
"  SELECT COALESCE(bool_and(opportunity_closed), false) AS all_opportunities_closed FROM vehicle_candidates\n" +
"), chatwoot_control AS (\n" +
"  SELECT is_chatwoot_bot_suppressed((SELECT chatwoot_conversation_id FROM inbound)) AS bot_suppressed\n" +
"), advisor_route AS (\n" +
"  SELECT * FROM resolve_inbound_advisor((SELECT phone FROM inbound))\n" +
"), conversation_state AS (\n" +
"  SELECT state.* FROM inbound CROSS JOIN LATERAL reconcile_chatwoot_conversation(\n" +
"    (SELECT id FROM customer_match), NULL::uuid, inbound.chatwoot_conversation_id,\n" +
"    inbound.occurred_at, inbound.wa_message_id, 'Inbound Chatwoot WABA iniciado por WF-03B DEV'\n" +
"  ) state\n" +
"), conv AS (\n" +
"  SELECT state.conversation_id AS id, state.conversation_customer_id AS customer_id,\n" +
"         state.conversation_status AS status, state.conversation_identity_verified AS identity_verified,\n" +
"         state.conversation_persuasion_attempts AS persuasion_attempts, state.conversation_handoff_reason AS handoff_reason,\n" +
"         state.conversation_promotion_communicated AS promotion_communicated, state.conversation_contact_preference AS contact_preference,\n" +
"         state.conversation_renewal_term_months AS renewal_term_months,\n" +
"         state.conversation_payment_method_preference AS payment_method_preference,\n" +
"         state.stored_chatwoot_conversation_id AS chatwoot_conversation_id\n" +
"    FROM conversation_state state WHERE state.conversation_id IS NOT NULL\n" +
"), chatwoot_conflict AS (\n" +
"  SELECT state.chatwoot_conversation_conflict AS conflicting FROM conversation_state state\n" +
"), inserted_message AS (\n" +
"  INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender, message_type, content, wa_message_id, metadata, occurred_at)\n" +
"  SELECT conv.id, 'inbound'::message_direction, 'customer'::message_sender, inbound.message_type, inbound.content, NULLIF(inbound.wa_message_id, ''), inbound.metadata, inbound.occurred_at\n" +
"  FROM conv CROSS JOIN inbound\n" +
"  WHERE conv.id IS NOT NULL\n" +
"    AND NOT EXISTS (\n" +
"      SELECT 1 FROM messages legacy_chatwoot_event\n" +
"       WHERE legacy_chatwoot_event.conversation_id = conv.id\n" +
"         AND legacy_chatwoot_event.direction = 'inbound'::message_direction\n" +
"         AND legacy_chatwoot_event.metadata->>'source_channel' = 'chatwoot_waba'\n" +
"         AND NULLIF(inbound.metadata->>'chatwoot_account_id', '') IS NOT NULL\n" +
"         AND NULLIF(inbound.metadata->>'chatwoot_conversation_id', '') IS NOT NULL\n" +
"         AND NULLIF(inbound.metadata->>'chatwoot_message_id', '') IS NOT NULL\n" +
"         AND legacy_chatwoot_event.metadata->>'chatwoot_account_id' = inbound.metadata->>'chatwoot_account_id'\n" +
"         AND legacy_chatwoot_event.metadata->>'chatwoot_conversation_id' = inbound.metadata->>'chatwoot_conversation_id'\n" +
"         AND legacy_chatwoot_event.metadata->>'chatwoot_message_id' = inbound.metadata->>'chatwoot_message_id'\n" +
"    )\n" +
"  ON CONFLICT (wa_message_id) DO NOTHING\n" +
"  RETURNING id\n" +
"), correlation_conflict_log AS (\n" +
"  INSERT INTO interaction_logs (customer_id, conversation_id, event_type, correlation_id, payload, success, error_message)\n" +
"  SELECT conv.customer_id, conv.id, 'chatwoot_conversation_conflict', inbound.wa_message_id,\n" +
"         jsonb_build_object('source_channel', 'chatwoot_waba', 'reason', 'chatwoot_conversation_id_claimed'), false, 'CHATWOOT_CONVERSATION_CONFLICT'\n" +
"  FROM conv CROSS JOIN inbound WHERE COALESCE((SELECT conflicting FROM chatwoot_conflict), false)\n" +
"    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted_message)\n" +
"), pause AS (\n" +
"  SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(pause_customer_campaigns(cm.id, 'customer_inbound_chatwoot')), false) AS paused FROM customer_matches cm\n" +
"), history_rows AS (\n" +
"  SELECT m.direction, m.sender, m.content, m.occurred_at\n" +
"  FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = (SELECT id FROM conv)\n" +
"    AND (m.direction <> 'outbound' OR m.delivery_status IN ('accepted','sent','delivered','read') OR m.metadata->>'chatwoot_dry_run' = 'true')\n" +
"  ORDER BY m.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 12\n" +
"), history AS (\n" +
"  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('direction', direction, 'sender', sender, 'content', content, 'occurred_at', occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at), '[]'::jsonb) AS recent_messages\n" +
"  FROM history_rows\n" +
")\n" +
"SELECT\n" +
"  (SELECT phone FROM inbound) AS phone_e164,\n" +
"  (SELECT wa_message_id FROM inbound) AS wa_message_id,\n" +
"  NULLIF((SELECT metadata->>'provider_message_id' FROM inbound), '') AS provider_message_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT content FROM inbound) AS inbound_text,\n" +
"  (SELECT message_type FROM inbound) AS message_type,\n" +
"  (SELECT id FROM customer_match) AS customer_id,\n" +
"  COALESCE((SELECT max(match_count) FROM customer_matches), 0)::integer AS account_match_count,\n" +
"  COALESCE((SELECT max(vehicle_count) FROM vehicle_candidates), 0)::integer AS vehicle_count,\n" +
"  (SELECT options FROM vehicle_options) AS vehicle_options,\n" +
"  (SELECT all_opportunities_closed FROM vehicle_status) AS all_opportunities_closed,\n" +
"  (SELECT full_name FROM customer_match) AS full_name,\n" +
"  (SELECT brand FROM vehicle_context) AS vehicle_brand,\n" +
"  (SELECT model FROM vehicle_context) AS vehicle_model,\n" +
"  (SELECT vehicle_type FROM vehicle_context) AS vehicle_type,\n" +
"  (SELECT service_name FROM vehicle_context) AS service_name,\n" +
"  (SELECT expiration_date FROM vehicle_context) AS expiration_date,\n" +
"  (SELECT gps_status FROM vehicle_context) AS gps_status,\n" +
"  (SELECT opportunity_stage FROM vehicle_context) AS opportunity_stage,\n" +
"  (SELECT opportunity_closed FROM vehicle_context) AS opportunity_closed,\n" +
"  (SELECT campaign_paused FROM customer_match) AS campaign_paused,\n" +
"  (SELECT salesforce_contact_id FROM customer_match) AS salesforce_contact_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT salesforce_opportunity_id FROM vehicle_context) AS salesforce_opportunity_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT salesforce_contract_id FROM vehicle_context) AS salesforce_contract_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT salesforce_vehicle_id FROM vehicle_context) AS salesforce_vehicle_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT id FROM conv) AS conversation_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT status FROM conv) AS conversation_status,\n" +
"  (SELECT identity_verified FROM conv) AS identity_verified,\n" +
"  (SELECT persuasion_attempts FROM conv) AS persuasion_attempts,\n" +
"  (SELECT handoff_reason FROM conv) AS handoff_reason,\n" +
"  (SELECT promotion_communicated FROM conv) AS promotion_communicated,\n" +
"  (SELECT contact_preference FROM conv) AS contact_preference,\n" +
"  (SELECT renewal_term_months FROM conv) AS renewal_term_months,\n" +
"  (SELECT payment_method_preference FROM conv) AS payment_method_preference,\n" +
"  (SELECT runtime_chatwoot_conversation_id FROM conversation_state) AS chatwoot_conversation_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT stored_chatwoot_conversation_id FROM conversation_state) AS stored_chatwoot_conversation_id,\n" +
"  COALESCE((SELECT chatwoot_conversation_reconciled FROM conversation_state), false) AS chatwoot_conversation_reconciled,\n" +
"  COALESCE((SELECT chatwoot_conversation_conflict FROM conversation_state), false) AS chatwoot_conversation_conflict,\n" +
"  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted_message) AS message_inserted,\n" +
"  COALESCE((SELECT paused FROM pause), false) AS campaign_paused_now,\n" +
"  is_automatic_send_allowed(now()) AS automatic_send_allowed,\n" +
"  (SELECT recent_messages FROM history) AS recent_messages,\n" +
"  (SELECT routes_to FROM advisor_route) AS inbound_routes_to,\n" +
"  (SELECT multi_match FROM advisor_route) AS inbound_multi_match,\n" +
"  (SELECT advisor_id FROM advisor_route) AS inbound_advisor_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT salesforce_user_id FROM advisor_route) AS inbound_advisor_sf_user_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT advisor_name FROM advisor_route) AS inbound_advisor_name,\n" +
"  (SELECT chatwoot_agent_id FROM advisor_route) AS inbound_chatwoot_agent_id,\n" +
"  (SELECT is_supervisor FROM advisor_route) AS inbound_is_supervisor,\n" +
"  COALESCE((SELECT bot_suppressed FROM chatwoot_control), false) AS chatwoot_bot_suppressed,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.routing_status || '') + "'::text AS routing_status,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.sf_account_id || '') + "'::text AS sf_account_id,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.sf_contract_id || '') + "'::text AS sf_contract_id,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.sf_contract_status || '') + "'::text AS sf_contract_status,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.sf_contract_end_date || '') + "'::text AS sf_contract_end_date,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.chatwoot_account_id || '') + "'::text AS chatwoot_account_id,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.chatwoot_inbox_id || '') + "'::text AS chatwoot_inbox_id,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.chatwoot_inbox_name || '') + "'::text AS chatwoot_inbox_name,\n" +
"  " + (Number.isInteger(Number(item.media_attachment_count)) ? Number(item.media_attachment_count) : 0) + "::integer AS media_attachment_count,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.media_attachment_id || '') + "'::text AS media_attachment_id,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.media_url || '') + "'::text AS media_url,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.media_caption || '') + "'::text AS media_caption,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.media_mime_type || '') + "'::text AS media_mime_type,\n" +
"  '" + q(item.media_file_name || '') + "'::text AS media_file_name,\n" +
"  " + (Number.isFinite(Number(item.media_file_size)) && Number(item.media_file_size) > 0 ? Number(item.media_file_size) : "NULL") + "::bigint AS media_file_size;";

function monitorEnv(name) { try { return String($env[name] || '').trim(); } catch (error) { return ''; } }
function monitorPhone(value) {
  const raw = String(value || '').trim();
  const digits = raw.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
  if (raw.startsWith('+')) return digits ? '+' + digits : '';
  if (digits.startsWith('593')) return '+' + digits;
  if (digits.startsWith('0') && digits.length === 10) return '+593' + digits.slice(1);
  if (digits.length === 9 && digits.startsWith('9')) return '+593' + digits;
  return digits ? '+' + digits : '';
}
const monitorRequested = (function () {
  if (String(item.message_text || '').trim().toLowerCase() !== 'monitor') return false;
  const allowed = monitorEnv('RENOV_DEV_MONITOR_OPERATOR_PHONES')
    .split(',').map(function (entry) { return monitorPhone(entry); }).filter(Boolean);
  if (!allowed.length) return false;
  const sender = monitorPhone(item.phone_e164 || item.phone || '');
  return Boolean(sender) && allowed.indexOf(sender) !== -1;
})();
const monitorColumns = [
  "  true::boolean AS monitor_requested",
  "  60::integer AS monitor_window_minutes",
  "  (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM interaction_logs WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '60 minutes' AND success = false AND event_type NOT IN ('pilot_observability_alert','pilot_observability_alert_config_missing')) AS monitor_interaction_failures",
  "  (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM interaction_logs WHERE event_type = 'wf03b_chatwoot_waba_inbound' AND created_at >= now() - interval '60 minutes' AND payload #>> '{metadata,llm_fallback_used}' = 'true' AND payload #>> '{metadata,llm_provider}' IS NULL) AS monitor_double_llm_failures",
  "  (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM interaction_logs WHERE event_type = 'wf03b_chatwoot_waba_inbound' AND created_at >= now() - interval '60 minutes' AND success = false AND payload->>'chatwoot_send_status' = '404') AS monitor_chatwoot_reply_not_found",
  "  (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM quicklink_campaign_dispatches WHERE dev_simulate_http_status IS NULL AND status = 'failed' AND updated_at >= now() - interval '60 minutes') AS monitor_dispatch_terminal",
  "  (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM quicklink_campaign_dispatches WHERE dev_simulate_http_status IS NULL AND status = 'queued' AND process_after < now() - interval '15 minutes') AS monitor_dispatch_stalled",
  "  (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM salesforce_callback_events WHERE state = 'queued') AS monitor_callback_queued",
  "  (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM chatwoot_handoff_operations WHERE operation_status = 'running' AND started_at < now() - interval '15 minutes') AS monitor_handoff_stalled",
  "  (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM chatwoot_handoff_operations WHERE operation_status = 'uncertain') AS monitor_handoff_uncertain"
];
const persistSql = monitorRequested
  ? sql.replace(/;\s*$/, '') + ',\n' + monitorColumns.join(',\n') + ';'
  : sql;

return [{ json: { ...item, monitor_requested: monitorRequested, persist_sql: persistSql } }];

parameters.content:
## REN - DEV - WF-03B - Chatwoot WABA Inbound Camila

Porta el patron de entrada Chatwoot de `CRIS-01 - Inbound Master` (ID fuente 3eNH717Puuma0ec8) a Renovaciones.

Canal objetivo: inbox WABA `Agente AIGENTS RENOVACIONES 9663`.

Reglas Renovaciones:
- filtra solo `message_created` incoming de contacto
- ignora otros inboxes, salientes y notas privadas
- schema `renovation_dev`
- pausa campanas por inbound
- ruteo Salesforce DEV o modo local DEV con `RENOV_DEV_USE_LOCAL_LEADS=true`
- off-hours Ecuador
- Camila con guardrails y handoff WF-04
- responde por Chatwoot, no por Meta directo

Mantener inactivo hasta conectar el webhook en Chatwoot y validar variables DEV.

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $json;
return [{ json: {
  ...item,
  ownership_sql: "SELECT
  renovation_dev.is_chatwoot_bot_suppressed($1::text) AS human_suppressed,
  (SELECT conversation.status::text
     FROM renovation_dev.conversations conversation
    WHERE conversation.id = NULLIF($2::text, '')::uuid
    LIMIT 1) AS conversation_status_now,
  (SELECT operation.operation_status
     FROM renovation_dev.chatwoot_handoff_operations operation
    WHERE operation.conversation_id = NULLIF($2::text, '')::uuid
      AND operation.operation_status IN ('running', 'uncertain')
    ORDER BY operation.started_at DESC
    LIMIT 1) AS handoff_operation_status_now;",
  ownership_params: [
    String(item.chatwoot_conversation_id || ''),
    String(item.conversation_id || ''),
  ],
} }];
